title: A0 with a zero-phase envelope (offline reference, not pre-registered)
description: A0 (the chosen setting) with one change: the EMG envelope is zero-phase (forward-backward band-pass and 2nd-order 2 Hz low-pass, envelope down-sampled with zero-phase decimation) instead of causal. It uses about 0.12 s of later EMG at every sample, so it is not possible in real time: an offline upper bound that measures what the causal envelope costs. Descriptive only; not one of the pre-registered comparisons (deviation 2026-11-23). Seeds 10-19, as A0.
